$comment: Human-reviewed allow-list for scripts/gen-socket-contract.mjs (unit S5, spec §5.5). Every entry below is a CURRENT, VERIFIED gap between the 43-event client catalogue (apps/elitea-ui/src/common/constants.js:881-936) and the Go server's registered client.On(...) handlers (services/elitea-main/internal/api/socketio/server.go). direction:'client-only' = the client declares the event, the server has no listener for it. direction:'server-only' = the server registers a listener for an event name absent from the client's 43-event catalogue (none exist today). Adding a NEW entry requires human review — the generator fails the build if it finds a gap that isn't listed here, and also fails if a listed entry no longer corresponds to a real gap (stale-allow-list hygiene). Regenerate deliberately; do not add an entry just to silence a failure without investigating whether it is a real, expected gap.

knownGaps.reason: Client-side-only synthetic event name (Chat/hooks.js:1527 listens for it), used to route socket-level validation errors into the chat error UI. No server.go emitter or listener registers this literal string — likely surfaced by socket.io's own error middleware/ack path rather than an application-level emit, or a vestige of the pre-Go (Python/Pylon) backend. Flagged, not silently dropped.
